Class ExpressionValueTags

java.lang.Object
org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.core.evaluate.expression.tree.ExpressionValueTags
public final class ExpressionValueTags extends Object
The tags of values that are written with their type in the text of expressions, as in @Fluid{amount: 1000, id: "water"}. Value types write their value in a field "v", which the text leaves out, so values are written as in commands. Lists, which write more than that field, are written as a whole, and items as their stack, with a count above 99 in it.
